positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence from rented intelligence, and what does the individual retain when the substrate is commoditized?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: a plain-spoken technical maxim that frames intelligence as property whose value differs by acquisition mode, appealing to autonomy and self-origination as the retained good. src-1 draws the owned/rented antithesis; src-2 names what persists — perspective as the kept asset against the commodified substrate. They share register (aphoristic, technical yet plain-spoken), conviction (unhedged claim), and value axis (ownership as the distinguishing good).
